owner_posts.post_text:
How does prenatal Yoga help?
In today’s fast-paced world, juggling between work and personal life can be a daunting task. This challenge is especially felt by working mothers who strive to strike a balance between their office duties and home responsibilities. Amidst this, the health of the mother and her baby takes paramount importance. Normal delivery is often preferred over C-section for various health benefits it offers to both the mother and child. And guess what? You can significantly improve your chances for a normal delivery by practicing prenatal yoga. Yes, you read that right! We are thrilled to share that all those who practiced prenatal yoga with us have indeed had normal deliveries. Are you interested in being one of them? If yes, sign up for our prenatal yoga sessions today!

What is Hatha Yoga?

The term Hatha is derived from two Sanskrit root sounds ‘ha’ and ‘tha’. The sound Ha represents the solar flow in the right nostril (Pingla Nadi) whereas Tha stands for the lunar flow in the left nostril (Ida Nadi). These sounds signify two opposite forces; positive and negative respectively. Asanas, Pranayamas, Mudras, Bandhas and Satkarmas together form the system of Hatha Yoga.

Hatha Yoga works on physical, psychophysical and psychological aspects and is also known as the Physiological Yoga the Ghatsya Yoga. Yogi Gorakshnath, a disciple of Yogi Matsyendrantah–founder of Hatha Yoga is considered as the reformist Hatha Yogi of his era. He traveled across India to teach systematic Yoga—now known as the system of Hatha Yoga. Hatha Yoga Pradipika, the Sanskrit manual on Hatha Yoga was written by Gorakshnath’s disciple Swami Swatmarma.

A girl who couldn't bend any part of her body properly, now does so many asanas with you, so confidently, so happily. My body has shown remarkable results in terms of health and flexibility.The transformation in my body seems unreal, but its real.

Sofia, i bow down to you with all my heart for becoming a part of my life, adding more meaning to it and inspiring me every day.🙏

Thanking you 💐

Warm regards
